products.name: Noor Kundan Jhumka Earrings
products.alt: Gold-plated kundan jhumka earrings with white stones and pearl fringe
products.short: Bell-shaped gold-tone jhumkas set with white kundan stones and a fringe of faux pearls.
products.description:
Our Noor jhumkas pair a floral kundan stud with a domed bell finished in fine gold-tone plating and edged with faux pearls. Lightweight enough for a full evening, they suit mehndi, Eid and wedding looks.

Material: brass alloy with gold-tone plating, kundan glass stones, faux pearls.
Length: approx. 5.5 cm. Push-back closure.
Care: keep dry, avoid perfume, store in the Ayatcollections pouch.

products.name: Zara Pearl Drop Earrings
products.alt: Gold-tone pearl drop earrings with zircon studs
products.short: A clean faux-pearl drop on a sparkling zircon stud — made for every day.
products.description:
Zara drops hang a lustrous faux pearl from a polished gold-tone cone and a single cubic zirconia stud. Simple enough for work, elegant enough for dinner.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, cubic zirconia, faux pearl.
Length: approx. 2.5 cm. Butterfly back.
Care: wipe with a soft dry cloth after wearing.

products.name: Rania Kundan Choker
products.alt: Gold-plated kundan choker with ruby and emerald stones and pearl drops
products.short: A bridal-weight choker of kundan, ruby-red and emerald-green stones with pearl drops.
products.description:
Rania is our statement choker: rows of kundan framed with ruby-red and emerald-green stones, finished with a cascade of faux pearl drops. Adjustable dori tie at the back.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, kundan glass stones, coloured glass stones, faux pearls.
Fit: adjustable, 30–38 cm.
Care: store flat in its box; avoid water and perfume.

products.name: Mehr Layered Pendant Necklace
products.alt: Three-layer gold-tone chain necklace with crescent charm and purple stone
products.short: Three fine chains with a crescent charm and a purple stone pendant.
products.description:
Mehr layers three delicate gold-tone chains — a beaded strand, a crescent moon charm and a small purple stone drop — on one clasp, so they never tangle.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, glass stone.
Length: 40 / 45 / 50 cm with 5 cm extender. Lobster clasp.
Care: fasten before storing to keep the layers apart.

products.name: Laila Gold Kara Bangle Set
products.alt: Set of four engraved gold-plated kara bangles
products.short: Four engraved gold-tone karas, sold as a set. Choose your bangle size.
products.description:
The Laila set is four engraved karas with a soft, hand-polished shine. Wear all four together or split them across both wrists.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Sizes: 2.4 (small), 2.6 (medium), 2.8 (large) — the inner diameter in inches.
Care: remove before washing hands; store in the pouch.

products.name: Sana Zircon Tennis Bracelet
products.short: A continuous line of sparkling cubic zirconia in a silver-tone setting.
products.description:
Sana is a classic tennis bracelet with a full row of round cubic zirconia stones in four-claw settings and a secure box clasp.

Material: alloy with rhodium-tone plating, cubic zirconia.
Length: 17.5 cm.
Care: clean gently with a soft brush and dry cloth.

products.name: Hira Emerald Cocktail Ring
products.alt: Gold-plated cocktail ring with oval green stone and zircon halo
products.short: An oval emerald-green stone in a halo of zircons. Choose your ring size.
products.description:
Hira sets a large oval emerald-green stone in a bright halo of small zircons on a gold-tone band — an easy way to finish a festive look.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, glass stone, cubic zirconia.
Sizes: 6, 7, 8 (US).
Care: remove before applying lotion or perfume.

products.name: Amal Stackable Ring Set
products.alt: Three thin stackable gold-tone rings, one with a small purple stone
products.short: Three slim bands — plain, pavé and a purple stone — to wear together or apart.
products.description:
Amal is a trio of slim stacking rings: a plain polished band, a pavé zircon band and a band set with a single purple stone. One size fits most (US 6–7).

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, cubic zirconia, glass stone.
Care: store each ring separately to avoid scratches.
